messages:
jordan (AM): Heads up — ArborTech POC starts tomorrow morning. Need final alignment on model variants and a few blockers: they want to test a 13B quantized variant and a 70B equivalent; also security Q asks if weights can be isolated on dedicated hardware. Pricing: request for a POC rate for ~100M tokens/month.

sanjay (infra): We can provision dedicated nodes for the 13B INT8 variant. 70B / 770B-class models are tight on our dedicated fleet right now unless we use hosted pooled capacity (higher latency).

maya (ml eng): I can run a quick compatibility scan this afternoon. Please drop the model repo or HF id + expected sequence length distribution.

elena (solutions): Customer will run clinical QA prompts ~avg 512 tokens, peak 2048. They also want example latency numbers and an eval harness we can hand them.

alex (sales-eng): For pricing the POC we typically do a one-off discount. Recommend 30% off hosted pricing for the first month + free dedicated burst for onboarding. Will that be feasible from ops? :moneybag:

sanjay (infra): 30% seems OK for hosted. For dedicated burst we need a ticket to scoping — I'll reserve a small pool but >30% sustained will need commit. :+1:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: dedicated-pool-arbortech provision job queued (run id: dp-2026-03-21-42).

maya (ml eng): Repo they sent: hf.co/arbortech/clinical-qamodel-v2. Quick notes after local scan: tokenizer matches, architecture is compatible but the checkpoints use fused ops that our runtime needs fallback kernels for. Run I used:
```
./compat-check --model hf://arbortech/clinical-qamodel-v2 --target runtime-v2 --check-ops
```
Found: 3 fused ops requiring generic kernels, adds ~6-12% inference CPU overhead on CPU fallback, GPU unaffected.

sanjay (infra): Important: 70B-class (the customer's 'high-accuracy' variant) requires 4x A100-80GB slices per replica. Reserved capacity is limited in the target region. Options: a) host 70B in our hosted multi-tenant and expose via routing policy, b) use a 13B quantized on dedicated + canary to hosted 70B for high-critical queries.

elena (solutions): For the security questionnaire Q re: "weights on dedicated hardware": we can confirm weights are stored encrypted at rest and keys are in KMS. For private deployments we can offer a VPC-deployed control plane and HSM integration. I'll draft the written answer. :lock:

alex (sales-eng): TL;DR for the customer on cost/flow: POC run plan: 13B-INT8 on Dedicated (primary), hosted 70B fallback for complex queries. POC price = hosted token price * 0.7 for first 30 days + no infra charge for first 48h of provisioning. Will confirm SOW language.

jordan (AM): Can we get latency benchmarks for 512/2048 tokens for both variants (13B int8 dedicated and hosted 70B) and a short eval report by EOD? Need to share with customer and update SOW.

maya (ml eng): On it. Quick numbers from my test cluster (single replica, batch=1):
```
13B-INT8 (dedicated): 512 -> 120ms avg, 2048 -> 460ms avg
70B (hosted multi-tenant): 512 -> 320ms avg, 2048 -> 1100ms avg
```
I'll run a 24h perf run overnight and attach full CSV tomorrow.

sanjay (infra): Routing config for fallback (sketch):
```
policy {
  route_primary: model:arbortech/13b-int8 if capacity_available
  else route_fallback: model:arbortech/70b-hosted
  timeout_ms: 1500
  logs: enable
}
```
This keeps P99 for primary low and falls back when dedicated is saturated.

elena (solutions): Security answer draft: "Weights are encrypted at rest using AES-256 with customer-isolated KMS keys; no SSH or hypervisor access is provided to customer tenants; audit logs retained per enterprise SLA." I'll add HSM wording for Private customers.

alex (sales-eng): One more ask from procurement: can we provide a short note on data residency for tokens processed during POC? Customer in EU.

sanjay (infra): We'll route POC traffic to eu-west-1 nodes and ensure logs stay in EU region. Add region pinning to the SOW.

jordan (AM): Great. Action items: (1) maya: 24h perf + CSV + eval report (2) elena: security questionnaire answers + SOW wording for fallback and region pinning (3) alex: update pricing in the SOW with the 30% POC discount and 48h free provisioning clause (4) sanjay: reserve dedicated pool and post exact capacity limits.

maya (ml eng): Got it. Will post results in the thread once finished. :eyes:

sanjay (infra): Reserving a 4-node 13B pool now — will confirm instance types and the exact replica count in an hour.

elena (solutions): Drafted the security Q answers and SOW snippets, dropping in #sales-docs shortly.

alex (sales-eng): I'll start a SOW draft and ping legal for expedited review.

jordan (AM): Thanks team — if we can get the perf + security answers today we can sign MSA and start onboarding tomorrow. :rocket:

maya (ml eng): Uploaded perf CSV and short eval summary to the thread: hf://artifacts/arbortech/poc/perf-1872501111.csv

sanjay (infra): Confirmed: dedicated pool = 4x g5g.12xlarge equivalents, expected sustained throughput ~6k tokens/s total.

elena (solutions): Security Q file uploaded to #sales-docs; adding HSM option language and region residency clause.

alex (sales-eng): SOW draft sent to legal for review. Will post link once approved.

jordan (AM): Awesome — closing the loop here. If any blocker pops up, ping me directly. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
